_comment: Global site settings. Anything wrapped in << >> is a placeholder that MUST be filled in before launch. Run `npm run build` to see which ones are still outstanding.

logo._comment: Logo file in src/assets/. Drop the official artwork in at this name (.svg or .png) and it is picked up on the next build. Set file to "" to fall back to a plain text wordmark.

lead._comment: Every destination below receives a copy of each registration, with the same JSON payload. required:true means the registrant flow depends on it (GHL sends the confirmation email and reminders). Non-required destinations are best-effort: they are still awaited so the data lands, but a failure never blocks or errors a signup.

destinations.name: Google Sheet
destinations._note: text/plain keeps this a CORS 'simple request'. Apps Script web apps do not answer the OPTIONS preflight that application/json would trigger, so the POST would be blocked by the browser before it was ever sent. The body is still JSON - read it in doPost with JSON.parse(e.postData.contents).
